title: Least privilege applied to the network

videos.script: Least privilege sounds like a principle. On a network it is a list: which machine may open a connection to which, on which port, and for how long. {{list}} In this lesson the database learns to accept one client for each of its two services, and to start no connections at all. {{db}} Administration gets one way in, a jump host, and a key that refuses to work anywhere else, even when it is copied. {{jump}} A supplier gets access for a few seconds, and loses it when the clock says so, with nobody having to remember. {{expire}} Last, how the firewall's own counters show which privileges nobody uses any more. {{audit}}
